title: Lab: Build, Ship, Run
intro_md: Containerize a web app end to end: build an image, run it with a port mapping, inspect it from inside, and clean up.

steps.instruction_md: Build an image from the Dockerfile in the current directory, tagged `myapp:v1`.
steps.hint: -t tags the image; don't forget the build context (the dot).

steps.instruction_md: Run it detached, named `web`, mapping host port 8080 to container port 3000.
List running containers to confirm `web` is up.
steps.mock_output:
CONTAINER ID  IMAGE      STATUS         PORTS                   NAMES
e3b0c44298fc  myapp:v1   Up 5 seconds   0.0.0.0:8080->3000/tcp  web
steps.hint: The command that lists running containers only.
docker logs with the follow flag.

steps.instruction_md: Open an interactive shell (`sh`) inside the running container.
Stop the container, then remove it (two commands chained with &&).
expected_commands: docker stop web && docker rm web
steps.hint: stop then rm — or force-remove in one shot.
